title: API status
description: Reachability of the Irbis API and its database.
degraded: The API answers, but the database is unreachable. Places, lessons and settings cannot be loaded or saved.
errorDescription: We could not reach the Irbis API. Check that it is running, then try again.
offlineNoData: You are offline. The API status will be checked when you reconnect.
stale: Last known status — it may be out of date.
